summary_zh: 本页标题为“顺手牵羊”，配有一名身穿铠甲、披着红色披风的古代武将插图，表情若有所思，似乎在谋划计策。

page_text_ocr_zh: 公元383年的冬天，在寒风呼啸的淝水两岸，各驻扎着一支军队。在淝水北岸的寿阳城里，驻扎的是前秦苻坚的八千骑兵。每天还有将领带着大军来跟苻坚会合，等人到齐，秦军总人数就有九十万了。
page_text_en: In the winter of 383 AD, with howling cold winds, armies were stationed on both banks of the Fei River. In the city of Shouyang on the north bank of the Fei River, the 8,000 cavalry of Former Qin's Fu Jian were stationed. Every day, generals led large armies to join Fu Jian. Once everyone arrived, the total number of Qin troops would reach 900,000.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了公元383年冬天淝水两岸的军事对峙场景，前秦苻坚的军队在寿阳城驻扎，兵力不断集结，总人数号称九十万。

page_text_ocr_zh: 在淝水南岸，有八座连绵起伏的山峰，名叫八公山。这里处处都是悬崖峭壁，浪花拍打岩石的砰砰声，都快把人的耳朵震聋了。八公山脚下，驻扎的就是东晋大将军谢玄的八万精兵。
page_text_en: On the southern bank of the Fei River, there are eight undulating mountain peaks called Baogong Mountain. Here, everywhere are steep cliffs and precipices, and the pounding sound of waves hitting the rocks is almost deafening. At the foot of Baogong Mountain, stationed are the 80,000 elite troops of Eastern Jin's General Xie Xuan.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了淝水南岸八公山的险峻地形，并说明东晋大将军谢玄的八万精兵在此驻扎。

page_text_ocr_zh:
九十万对战八万！
苻坚手握马鞭，骄傲地说："我的士兵把马鞭投进江里，就能让江水断流，怎么会打不过小小的东晋呢？"
page_text_en:
Nine hundred thousand versus eighty thousand!
Fu Jian, holding his whip, proudly said: "If my soldiers throw their whips into the river, they could cut off the flow of water. How could we possibly lose to the tiny Eastern Jin?"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了前秦苻坚在淝水北岸夸耀兵力，认为九十万大军足以碾压东晋八万精兵，表现出其极度的骄傲与轻敌。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这天，北风呼呼地吹着，好像就要下雪了。苻坚登上寿阳城墙，望向对岸的晋军。
淝水南岸，水中的战船，一艘挨着一艘，战旗随风飘扬。晋军穿着厚实的盔甲，列阵训练，各个威武雄壮。
page_text_en:
That day, the north wind howled, as if it were about to snow. Fu Jian climbed onto the walls of Shouyang and looked across at the Jin army.
On the southern bank of the Fei River, warships lined up one after another on the water, their battle flags fluttering in the wind. The Jin soldiers wore thick armor, drilled in formation, each one mighty and heroic.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了淝水之战前夕的对峙场景：前秦苻坚登上寿阳城墙，眺望对岸的东晋军队，画面展现了晋军在淝水南岸战船林立、列阵训练的威武景象，突显双方军事力量的对比。

page_text_ocr_zh: 一阵西北风呼啦啦吹过，晋军军营后的八公山上树摇草晃，好像是无数的晋军在摇旗呐喊。苻坚这才有点担心了："晋军这么多人，是我们的劲敌呀！"可是，他转念又一想："怕什么呀，我们一人朝晋军射一箭，就能把他们射成马蜂窝。"
page_text_en: A strong northwest wind blew, and on the Baogong Mountain behind the Jin army's camp, trees swayed and grasses trembled, as if countless Jin soldiers were waving flags and shouting. Fu Jian began to feel a bit worried: "The Jin army has so many troops—they are our formidable enemies!" But then he thought to himself: "What's there to fear? If each of us shoots one arrow at the Jin army, we could turn them into a beehive!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了淝水之战前夕，前秦苻坚在寿阳城观察对岸晋军时的心理活动。尽管八公山的草木摇动让他一度心生疑虑，但他很快又因兵力优势而重拾轻敌心态，认为只需一箭即可击溃晋军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
晋军营帐里，谢玄大将军已经收到消息，秦军九十万大军还没有到齐呢！他胸有成竹地说：‘我们要趁这个机会，打败秦军。’
‘可是秦军在对岸守得很严，我们打不过去呀！’一位将领为难地说。谢玄哈哈大笑：‘可以请他们往后退一退，放我们上岸呀！’‘这怎么可能呢！’大家都觉得谢玄在说笑话。
page_text_en:
In the Jin army's camp, General Xie Xuan had received word that the Qin army's nine hundred thousand troops were not yet fully assembled. He said confidently, 'We must seize this opportunity to defeat the Qin army.'
'But the Qin army is guarding the opposite bank tightly; we can't get across!' a general said, troubled. Xie Xuan laughed heartily, 'We can ask them to retreat a bit and let us land!' 'How is that possible!' Everyone thought Xie Xuan was joking.
summary_zh: 在晋军营帐中，谢玄得知秦军尚未集结完毕，决定趁机出击。他提出让秦军后退以便晋军渡河的计策，但其他将领认为这不可能，觉得他在开玩笑。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天，谢玄派人乘着一艘小船，渡过淝水，给苻坚送去了一封挑战书：你秦军来到我东晋，驻扎在淝水边，进不能进，退不能退，这不能白白耗费粮草吗？如果你有胆量，就向后退十里，让我晋军渡过淝水，与你决一死战！
page_text_en: The next day, Xie Xuan sent a messenger in a small boat across the Fei River to deliver a challenge to Fu Jian: 'Your Qin army has come to our Eastern Jin territory, stationed by the Fei River. You cannot advance, nor can you retreat. Isn't this just wasting provisions? If you have the courage, retreat ten li. Let our Jin army cross the Fei River and fight you to the death!'
summary_zh: 谢玄派人渡过淝水，向苻坚递交挑战书，要求秦军后退十里，以便晋军渡河决战，以此试探对方胆量并为后续作战创造机会。

page_text_ocr_zh: 苻坚一目十行地读完信，提起笔就在下面写了一个斗大的字："好！"
page_text_en: Fu Jian read the letter at a glance, then picked up his brush and wrote a large character below: "Good!"
summary_zh: 苻坚读完谢玄的挑战书后，毫不犹豫地在木板上写下“好”字，表现出他轻敌且自信满满的态度，而身边的秦军士兵则面露惊恐。

page_text_ocr_zh: "不行，千万不能后退呀！"前秦将领都不同意放晋军过河！苻坚却满不在乎地说："九十万大军最少要半个月才能到齐，太浪费时间！我们先假装答应后退，等晋军过来一半，我们的骑兵精锐冲上去，一通攻打，马上就会大获全胜！速战速决，我们今年就能在东晋的都城建康过年了！"
page_text_en: "No, we must not retreat!" The Qin generals all disagreed with letting the Jin army cross the river! Fu Jian, however, shrugged it off and said: "Our army of nine hundred thousand will take at least half a month to gather completely—too much wasted time! Let’s pretend to agree to retreat. Once half the Jin army has crossed, our elite cavalry will charge in, strike hard, and we’ll win a great victory immediately! We’ll end this quickly and celebrate the New Year in Jiankang, the capital of the Jin dynasty, this very year!"
summary_zh: 苻坚不顾将领反对，决定假装答应晋军后退，计划在晋军渡河一半时发动突袭，以速战速决的方式取得胜利。

page_text_ocr_zh: 不顾众将领的反对，苻坚与谢玄约定了渡河的时间，还叮嘱将领们说：‘此事机密，万万不可泄露出去！’
page_text_en: Ignoring the opposition of his generals, Fu Jian agreed with Xie Xuan on the time for crossing the river, and instructed his commanders: 'This matter is confidential; under no circumstances should it be revealed!'
summary_zh: 苻坚不顾将领反对，与谢玄约定渡河时间，并严令保密，为后续的军事行动做准备。

page_text_ocr_zh: 约定的时间很快就到了。这天吃过早饭，苻坚就下达了命令：全军后撤十里。近处的士兵接到命令，一边高兴地后撤，一边说："太好了，我们可以回家过年了！""我家有几十亩地，还等我回去耕呢！""回家好，还是我娘做的臊子面吃着香！"
page_text_en: The agreed-upon time had arrived. After breakfast that day, Fu Jian issued the order: 'The entire army will retreat ten li.' The nearby soldiers, upon receiving the order, happily began to retreat, saying: "Great! We can go home for the New Year!" "I have dozens of mu of land waiting for me to plow!" "Going home is best—nothing beats my mother's sauced noodles!"
summary_zh: 苻坚下令全军后撤十里，士兵们误以为战争结束，兴高采烈地谈论着回家过年、耕田和吃母亲做的臊子面，表现出对战局的轻视和对胜利的盲目乐观。

page_text_ocr_zh:
只见波涛滚滚的淝水上，
一艘艘飘着战旗的战船，
正乘风破浪而来。

可淝水边的秦兵还没等接到撤退
的命令，就听到有人喊："晋军过
河了！""秦军败了！""快快逃命吧！"
page_text_en:
On the surging waters of the Fei River,
row upon row of warships flying battle flags
were charging forward with the wind.

The Qin soldiers by the Fei River had not yet received the order to retreat
when they heard someone shouting: "The Jin army has crossed the river!" "The Qin army has lost!" "Run for your lives!"
summary_zh: 晋军战船乘风破浪渡过淝水，秦军士兵在未接到撤退命令时便听到战败消息，惊慌失措，纷纷逃命。

page_text_ocr_zh:
再回头一看，士兵们大吃一惊，大军都在撤退呀！他们也不想打仗，拎起兵器撒腿就跑，苻坚埋伏的骑兵也被他们冲散了。
可是，路只有那么宽，大军争着抢着往后逃，不是人踩到了人，就是马踏到了人。晋军还没有上岸，漫山遍野就都是被踩死踏伤的秦兵了。
page_text_en:
Looking back, the soldiers were shocked to see the entire army retreating! They didn't want to fight anymore, grabbing their weapons and running away. Even the cavalry hidden by Fu Jian were scattered by the panic.
But the road was so narrow that the army, scrambling to flee, trampled each other—some stepped on people, others were crushed by horses. The Jin army hadn't even landed yet, and already the hills were covered with Qin soldiers trampled to death or injured.
summary_zh: 秦军在混乱中争相后撤，因道路狭窄互相踩踏，造成大量伤亡，而晋军尚未上岸，战场上已尸横遍野。

page_text_ocr_zh:
晋军紧追不舍，逃跑的秦兵吓破了胆，丢了兵器，扔了盔甲。一路上风声呼呼，鹤鸣呖呖。秦军以为是晋军追上来了，不管白天黑夜没命地跑。
这场淝水之战，苻坚的弟弟苻融丢了性命，苻坚的肩膀也中了箭，最后只带着十几万败兵败将，灰溜溜地逃回了长安。
page_text_en:
The Jin army pursued relentlessly. The fleeing Qin soldiers were terrified, dropping their weapons and armor. Along the way, the wind howled and cranes cried. The Qin army thought the Jin forces were catching up, so they ran for their lives, day and night.
In this Battle of Fei River, Fu Jian's brother Fu Rong lost his life, and Fu Jian himself was wounded in the shoulder by an arrow. In the end, he fled back to Chang'an with only a few dozen thousand defeated soldiers and generals, in disgrace.
summary_zh: 晋军追击溃败的秦军，秦兵惊慌失措，丢盔弃甲，一路上风声鹤唳，以为晋军追至。淝水之战中，苻坚的弟弟苻融战死，苻坚本人也负伤，最终仅率残兵败将狼狈逃回长安。

page_text_ocr_zh:
苻坚骄傲自大，急着打胜仗，谢玄便趁着他兵马未齐，用计激他答应退兵十里，请晋军渡河。渡河的时候，晋军又意外地发现，淝水边的秦兵还没收到撤退的命令，就让人大喊“秦军败了”，吓得秦兵惊慌失措地逃跑了。

机会就像羊脖子上的绳子，而胜利就像被栓住的羊。谢玄抓住了一次次的机会，才能像顺手牵羊一样，轻松地取得胜利。
page_text_en:
Fu Jian was arrogant and eager to win. Xie Xuan took advantage of his unprepared army and tricked him into agreeing to retreat ten li, allowing the Jin army to cross the river. When crossing, the Jin army unexpectedly found that the Qin soldiers by the Fei River had not yet received the retreat order, so they shouted, "The Qin army has lost!" This frightened the Qin soldiers, who panicked and fled.

Opportunity is like the rope around a sheep's neck, and victory is like the sheep being tied up. Xie Xuan seized opportunity after opportunity, and thus could easily win, just like leading a sheep by the rope.
summary_zh: 本页描述了淝水之战中，谢玄利用苻坚轻敌的心理，通过计策诱使秦军后退，并在渡河时制造秦军战败的假象，导致秦军惊慌溃逃。同时，通过比喻说明谢玄善于把握战机，最终轻松取胜。
